scope: Real task experiments, not substituted by CI prerequisites or protocol fixtures

cards.title: Propagate one real shared-core change to four terminals
preconditions: Five published exact candidates with one core pin and reviewed CI
Real saved Mission and existing authorized hosted tasks at the exact checkouts
procedure: Read the exact Mission through all four actual native frontends
Run the original task validation through existing authorized controls
Read each exact task/run receipt and rerun the read-only continuation preflight
Inspect the Mission after all actual validation/publication requirements are met
acceptance: Actual core and four adapter paths are covered by task evidence
Four native frontends display the same saved identity and scoped receipts
Record all three real repetitions and raw evidence hashes
non_substitutes: Fake providers or database-seeded receipt rows

cards.title: Reproduce and repair stale inspection or review evidence
preconditions: A real reproducible stale receipt scenario in disposable task worktrees
Do not mutate the frozen positive acceptance checkouts
procedure: Capture the current receipt and its exact task/run/sequence
Change the actual acceptance contract or worktree through authorized controls
Verify old evidence stays stale and Needs-you persists across refresh/reopen
Repair the cause and run a new original validation after the new evidence boundary
acceptance: An old or late receipt cannot restore current success
A new real validation receipt is bound to the changed contract and checkout
Record all three real repetitions and raw evidence hashes

cards.title: Observe real partial publication and eventual integration
preconditions: An authorized staged real publication with fixed candidate identities
No forced push and no writes from this read-only preflight
procedure: Observe a real unpublished local candidate and dated current public master
Record the actual repository publication and integration transitions
Distinguish a wrong dependency pin from missing remote ancestry
Reopen the host and re-inspect the exact saved plan without restoring historical pass gates
acceptance: Dated public refs and ancestry identify the actual staged candidates
Partial integration cannot be called complete
Record all three real repetitions and raw evidence hashes
non_substitutes: A negative local clone used by host-contract tests
A provider narrative claiming it pushed
